title: Cheese Malawach Burekas
subtitle: with yellow cheese and feta
description: Frozen malawach pastry spread with yellow cheese and feta, rolled into logs and baked. Serve with a fresh salad and hot sauce if you like.

steps.text: Roll out the malawach on a floured surface to a square shape and cut in half to make two rectangles.
Mix the grated yellow cheese and feta in a bowl into an even filling.
Spread the filling over each rectangle (40 g of filling per piece of dough).
Roll the cheese-covered malawach into a closed log.
Brush the burekas with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds to taste.
Bake for about 20 minutes in an oven preheated to 180°C, or until the burekas turn golden.
